Meet Silver Spring Family Restaurant

The Agadis family's promise

Silver Spring Family Restaurant is a family-owned diner at 3653 Marietta Ave in Lancaster, PA. It's famous for serving breakfast all day, including homemade buttermilk pancakes and outstanding traditional local fare.

The Agadis family looks forward to providing their customers with fast and friendly service in a warm setting in the beautiful Lancaster County landscape. The restaurant is always busy for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
